instruction.text: Sieh dir die Sehenswürdigkeiten New Yorks genau an.
Ordne den Beschreibungen die passenden Sehenswürdigkeiten zu.

atoms.a: It is a huge statue of a woman, who holds a torch in her raised right hand. It is located on an Island in front of Manhattan. You can take a ferry to visit and see this statue. From this ferry you also get a great view of the skyline of New York.
It is a bridge that connects Manhattan and Brooklyn. It crosses the East River.
It is a skyscraper, which is nearly 450 meters tall. It was the world's tallest building for almost 40 years. From the top of this building you get a nice view over the city.
It is a big train station where many trains arrive and depart, connecting people to various destinations across the city and beyond.

instruction.text: Sieh dir die bekannten Orte in New York an.
Ordne den Beschreibungen die passenden bekannten Orte zu.

atoms.a: It is a huge urban-park in the middle of Manhattan. It is 4 kilometres long and 800 metres wide. In winter, you can go ice-skating on the Central Park lake.
It is a street and district in New York, that is famous for its bright, colourful lights as well as theatres and restaurants. The centre of this district is the famous Times Square.

It is a world-famous street, that crosses Manhattan from north to south. It is New Yorks most expensive shopping street. When you drive along this road, you can see the Flatiron, a very thin building in the middle of a crossing.

instruction.text: Ordne den Bildern der Sehenswürdigkeiten und Plätze ihre Namen zu.
